models_evaluated: parameter-locked mobile AI-assisted oral lesion triage system

links.outcome: Field performance of AI red triage for high-risk lesions versus expert reference in low-prevalence setting
links.quote: For high-risk lesion identification, sensitivity was 75.0% (95% CI 50.5%-89.8%) and positive predictive value was 17.6% (95% CI 10.4%-28.4%); specificity, negative predictive value, and accuracy were 98.6%, 99.9%, and 98.5%, respectively.

unlisted_practices: On-site image quality assessment with repeated acquisition attempts, excluding ungradable images
Parameter-locked model deployed in field screening by trained non-specialist personnel

screen.reason: Prospective field evaluation of a mobile AI-assisted oral lesion triage system deployed in real-world community screening, evaluating diagnostic accuracy without comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
